Theta GmbH's strategy of filing multiple patents for next-generation wireless communication poses a significant threat to our business. By securing these patents, they are likely to establish a temporary monopoly on key technologies, which could directly impede our own development efforts. This legal maneuver may force us to seek alternative solutions, potentially increasing our R&D costs and delaying our time-to-market. To mitigate this risk, we should consider conducting a thorough freedom-to-operate analysis, exploring workarounds, or potentially engaging in licensing negotiations.
